minecraft:pitcher_pod.what: A pitcher pod is an ancient plant starter dug up by sniffers.
minecraft:pitcher_pod.does: Plant it on farmland to grow a pitcher plant.

minecraft:pitcher_plant.what: A pitcher plant is a tall decorative ancient plant.
minecraft:pitcher_plant.does: Grow it from a pitcher pod and use the mature plant for decoration or compatible dye recipes.

minecraft:leaf_litter.what: Leaf litter is a decorative layer of fallen leaves.
minecraft:leaf_litter.does: Use it to give forest floors and gardens a natural leaf-covered appearance.

minecraft:pink_petals.what: Pink petals are a thin decorative layer of pink flowers.
minecraft:pink_petals.does: Use them to decorate gardens and cherry-grove-style ground.

minecraft:wildflowers.what: Wildflowers are a decorative spread of small flowers.
minecraft:wildflowers.does: Place them on suitable ground for natural-looking flower patches.

minecraft:firefly_bush.what: A firefly bush is a decorative bush associated with firefly-like ambient particles.
minecraft:firefly_bush.does: Use it to add natural atmosphere to a garden or waterside build.

minecraft:cactus_flower.what: A cactus flower is a decorative flower associated with cactus growth.
minecraft:cactus_flower.does: Use it for desert gardens and compatible crafting or dye recipes.

minecraft:golden_dandelion.what: A golden dandelion is a special flower used in baby-animal growth interactions.
minecraft:golden_dandelion.does: Use it on supported baby animals to control their growth; support depends on the animal.

minecraft:copper_chest.what: A copper chest is a storage block associated with copper golem item sorting.
minecraft:copper_chest.does: Use it as an input container for a suitable copper-golem sorting arrangement.

minecraft:copper_golem_statue.what: A copper golem statue is a decorative statue form associated with copper golems and oxidation.
minecraft:copper_golem_statue.does: Use it as decoration; waxing and oxidation affect copper forms and their interactions.

minecraft:camera.what: A camera is a special photography tool from compatible Minecraft Education features.
minecraft:camera.does: Use it in a supported Education world to capture images; it is not an ordinary Survival crafting station.

minecraft:piston_arm_collision.what: A piston head is the moving extension of a piston.
minecraft:piston_arm_collision.does: It pushes blocks when its piston extends. This internal block is part of the mechanism, rather than a normal separate Survival building item.

minecraft:sticky_piston_arm_collision.what: A sticky piston head is the moving extension of a sticky piston.
minecraft:sticky_piston_arm_collision.does: It participates in the piston pushing and pulling its attached block. It is part of the mechanism, not a normal separate Survival building item.

minecraft:netherbrick.what: A Nether brick is a material made by smelting netherrack.
minecraft:netherbrick.does: Combine it into Nether brick building blocks and related recipes.

minecraft:blue_egg.what: A blue egg is a colored chicken egg.
minecraft:blue_egg.does: Use it in compatible egg recipes or throw it for chicken-hatching interactions.

minecraft:brown_egg.what: A brown egg is a colored chicken egg.
minecraft:brown_egg.does: Use it in compatible egg recipes or throw it for chicken-hatching interactions.

minecraft:unknown.what: The unknown block is a placeholder used when Minecraft cannot identify a block properly.
minecraft:unknown.does: It is not a normal Survival resource. If it appears in a world unexpectedly, a required add-on or block definition may be missing.

minecraft:tnt.what: TNT is an explosive block that becomes a primed explosive entity when ignited.
minecraft:tnt.does: Use it for controlled explosions, keeping people, pets, and important builds well away from the blast.

minecraft:cinnabar.what: Cinnabar is a mineral building block with several decorative forms.
minecraft:cinnabar.does: Use it in construction or turn it into compatible polished, brick, stair, slab, and wall forms.

minecraft:polished_cinnabar.what: Polished cinnabar is a processed decorative cinnabar block.
minecraft:polished_cinnabar.does: Use it for smoother-looking construction or make compatible stairs, slabs, and walls.

minecraft:chiseled_cinnabar.what: Chiseled cinnabar is a carved decorative cinnabar block.
minecraft:chiseled_cinnabar.does: Use it for patterned accents in cinnabar builds; it can be made from suitable cinnabar materials.

minecraft:sulfur.what: Sulfur is a mineral block with several building variants.
minecraft:sulfur.does: Use it in construction or craft compatible polished, chiseled, stair, slab, and wall forms.

minecraft:polished_sulfur.what: Polished sulfur is a processed decorative sulfur block.
minecraft:polished_sulfur.does: Use it for construction or make compatible polished sulfur stairs, slabs, and walls.

minecraft:chiseled_sulfur.what: Chiseled sulfur is a carved decorative sulfur block.
minecraft:chiseled_sulfur.does: Use it to add a patterned sulfur detail to builds, using the appropriate crafting or stonecutting recipe.

minecraft:potent_sulfur.what: Potent sulfur is a special sulfur block made by combining sulfur.
minecraft:potent_sulfur.does: It has its own recipe and is distinct from ordinary sulfur. I still need to learn its special interactions.

minecraft:sulfur_spike.what: A sulfur spike is a pointed sulfur formation.
minecraft:sulfur_spike.does: It is different from the ordinary flat sulfur building block. I still need to learn its special interactions.

minecraft:shelf_mushroom.what: A shelf mushroom is a mushroom material with a shelf-like growth form.
minecraft:shelf_mushroom.does: Use it for suitable mushroom decoration and compatible food recipes, including rabbit stew.

minecraft:melon_stem.what: A melon stem is a crop plant grown from melon seeds.
minecraft:melon_stem.does: Grow it on farmland with a suitable adjacent space so it can produce melon blocks.

minecraft:pumpkin_stem.what: A pumpkin stem is a crop plant grown from pumpkin seeds.
minecraft:pumpkin_stem.does: Grow it on farmland with a suitable adjacent space so it can produce pumpkin blocks.

minecraft:mushroom_stem.what: A mushroom stem is the stalk block of a huge mushroom.
minecraft:mushroom_stem.does: Use it for mushroom-themed construction. Harvesting the intact block requires a suitable Silk Touch tool.
